scenes.vo: Tired of always being the shortest one in every group picture?
Don't stress. Most people never actually reach their full natural height.
Fixing three simple daily habits can unlock your tallest, straightest posture.
Number one: get eight full hours of sleep so your spinal discs decompress.
Number two: daily bar hanging and decompression stretches to lengthen your back.
Number three: clean nutrition with calcium and zero refined sugar spikes.
And there's way more inside our app. Predict your height in TallPlan.
